cards.ex: Sometimes blissful ignorance is better than knowing the truth.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan haqiqatni bilmaslik baxtli bexabarlikdan yaxshiroqdir.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida bilmaslikdan kelib chiqadigan baxt yoki xotirjamlik.

cards.ex: Watching my kids play together brings me pure joy.
cards.exUz: Farzandlarimning birga o'ynashini kuzatish menga sof xursandchilik keltiradi.

cards.ex: I'm feeling really on top of things this week; everything is going well.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni bu hafta juda yaxshi his qilyapman; hamma narsa yaxshi ketyapti.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani nazorat ostida ushlab turish, muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish.

cards.ex: I felt completely at ease after finishing the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha tugagandan keyin men o'zimni butunlay xotirjam his qildim.

cards.ex: Sometimes you just have to live for the moment and not worry so much.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan shunchaki hozir bilan yashash va ko'p tashvishlanmaslik kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakni o'ylamasdan, hozirgi paytdan zavq olish.

cards.ex: She's such a ray of sunshine; she always makes me laugh.
cards.exUz: U juda quyosh nuri; u har doim meni kuldiradi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning hayotiga baxt olib kiradigan odam.

cards.ex: The team was in high spirits after winning the game.
cards.exUz: Jamoa o'yinda g'alaba qozongandan so'ng ko'tarinki kayfiyatda edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va energiyaga to'la bo'lish.

cards.ex: Exercise and healthy eating contribute to a sense of well-being.
cards.exUz: Jismoniy mashqlar va sog'lom ovqatlanish farovonlik hissini oshiradi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi, sog'lom va baxtli his qilish.

cards.ex: She was floating on air after getting the job offer.
cards.exUz: U ish taklifini olgandan keyin havoda suzardi.

cards.ex: I take pleasure in simple things like a good cup of coffee.
cards.exUz: Men bir chashka yaxshi qahva kabi oddiy narsalardan zavq olaman.

cards.ex: Volunteering at the animal shelter was a truly fulfilling experience.
cards.exUz: Hayvonlar boshpanasida ko'ngilli bo'lish chinakam mazmunli tajriba edi.
cards.uzDef: Ruhan boyitadigan va qoniqish hissini beradigan tajriba.

cards.ex: I get a charge out of watching live music.
cards.exUz: Men jonli musiqani tomosha qilishdan katta quvvat olaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir katta zavq va hayajon olish.

cards.ex: After years of struggling, he finally felt at peace with himself.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yillik kurashdan so'ng, u nihoyat o'zini tinch his qildi.

cards.ex: He's got his family and his health; he's content as Larry.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi va sog'lig'i bor; u Larrydek qoniqqan.

cards.ex: The team is still basking in the glory of their championship win.
cards.exUz: Jamoa hali ham chempionlik g'alabasining shon-shuhratida cho'milmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z muvaffaqiyatingizdan zavq olish, shon-shuhratda yashamoq.

cards.ex: I tried to cheer her up with a funny story.
cards.exUz: Men uni kulgili hikoya bilan xursand qilishga harakat qildim.

cards.ex: She's in a good place right now, focused on her career and family.
cards.exUz: U hozir yaxshi holatda, faoliyati va oilasiga e'tibor qaratgan.
cards.uzDef: Ruhiy va hissiy jihatdan yaxshi holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Opening my own business was a dream come true.
cards.exUz: O'z biznesimni ochish orzuning ro'yobi edi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri orzu qilingan narsaning amalga oshishi.

cards.ex: Your kind words really made my day.
cards.exUz: Sizning mehribon so'zlaringiz meni juda xursand qildi.

cards.ex: He has a happy-go-lucky attitude towards life.
cards.exUz: Uning hayotga nisbatan xushchaqchaq munosabati bor.
cards.uzDef: Doim xursand va tashvishsiz, beparvo odam.

cards.ex: She burst with joy when she heard the news.
cards.exUz: U yangilikni eshitgach, quvonchga to'ldi.

cards.ex: I felt a warm glow after helping someone in need.
cards.exUz: Men muhtojga yordam bergandan keyin iliq his qildim.

cards.ex: She has a grateful heart and appreciates everything she has.
cards.exUz: Uning minnatdor qalbi bor va u bor narsalarni qadrlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsa uchun minnatdor bo'lgan qalb.

cards.ex: They're living the dream, traveling the world and seeing new places.
cards.exUz: Ular orzularini ro'yobga chiqarib, dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilib, yangi joylarni ko'rishmoqda.

cards.ex: I enjoy the simple pleasures of life, like a walk in the park.
cards.exUz: Men hayotning oddiy lazzatlaridan, masalan, parkda sayr qilishdan zavqlanaman.

cards.ex: Having a sense of purpose helps me get through tough times.
cards.exUz: Maqsad hissi menga qiyin paytlardan o'tishga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: Volunteering brings joy to my life.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilik mening hayotimga xursandchilik keltiradi.

cards.ex: I find solace in nature when I'm feeling stressed.
cards.exUz: Men stressda bo'lganimda tabiatdan tasalli topaman.

cards.ex: She was bursting with happiness when she saw her family.
cards.exUz: U oilasini ko'rganda baxtdan yorildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baxtli va quvonchga to'la bo'lish.

cards.ex: Meditation helps me achieve a state of bliss.
cards.exUz: Meditatsiya menga baxt holatiga erishishga yordam beradi.
